summary: First full-stack testing pass of SI SANTRI. Backend: 29/29 pytest tests passed covering auth (3 roles + name normalization + wrong password), student report upsert/no-duplicate/backfill/late-flag/validation, teacher dashboard/search/filter/detail/recap/add-student, parent dashboard/summary/history, and full RBAC isolation (403s). Frontend: manually verified via Playwright across all 3 roles - login role switcher + demo chips + error handling, student 5-step wizard (all steps, 'Lainnya' validation, exit-confirm modal, backfill flow to specific past date), teacher dashboard (KPI, search by name/NIPD, status filters, student detail with 7/30 recap, add-student modal), parent dashboard (single child, history, account/logout) - all functioned correctly end-to-end.

minor.issue: N+1 query pattern: loops through every student and does a separate find_one() daily_reports lookup per student instead of a single aggregation/$in query. Causes ~6-8s load time for teacher dashboard with only ~23 students against MongoDB Atlas; will scale poorly for teachers with more students or slower network.
Same N+1 pattern repeated per-day for 7 and 30 day recap computation (up to 30 sequential find_one queries) - contributes to slow student-detail page load (observed ~10-15s first load).

ui_bugs.issue: A LogBox dev warning 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>' rendered as a visible red banner overlay at the bottom of the teacher student detail screen. Could not pinpoint exact source file via static grep (no obvious stray text node in the detail screen or shared UI components) - likely from Expo Router Tabs internals rendering emoji+label icons. Cosmetic/dev-only but worth a deeper look before production.

action_items: Optimize GET /api/teacher/students and compute_recap to use a single aggregation ($in on student_ids + activity_date, or one query per date range) instead of per-student/per-day find_one loops - will fix slow teacher dashboard/detail load times.
Investigate and fix the 'Unexpected text node: .' RN warning surfaced on the teacher student detail screen (cosmetic dev-time LogBox banner, non-blocking).

Note: my own pytest run (test_add_student_and_immediate_login) added one TEST_ prefixed student to Catur Anjar Anggraini's class (7A) via the real add-student API, bumping her total from 22 to 23 in the live Atlas DB. This is expected side-effect of exercising the real endpoint (no mocks) - main agent may want to delete this seed student (name starts with 'TEST_Siswa') before demoing 'Total Siswa = 22' to stakeholders, or re-seed with --force.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/teacher.py: list_students() and compute_recap() use sequential await db.daily_reports.find_one() calls inside Python for-loops instead of a single $in query - functionally correct but not scalable; flagged as minor perf issue above.

Overall backend code is clean: proper async/await, Pydantic validation, role-based dependency injection for RBAC, _id excluded from all responses via clean_report(), env vars used correctly, friendly Indonesian error messages throughout.

Frontend code is clean: testID coverage is thorough on all interactive elements, StyleSheet.create used everywhere, text always wrapped in <Text>, KeyboardAvoidingView present on login, safe-area insets respected on all screens.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows functioned correctly (minor perf/cosmetic issues noted)

seed_data_creation: One TEST_ prefixed student+parent account was created in the live MongoDB Atlas DB via the real add-student endpoint during backend testing (nipd starts with 9, name 'TEST_Siswa {hex}') - flagged in action_items for cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 18 features/flows in the review request were tested and passed: login role-switcher+chips+normalization+wrong-password, student wizard (all 5 steps incl. 'Lainnya' validation, resubmit-no-duplicate verified via history list length check, backfill to specific past date, exit-confirm modal is a custom sheet not native Alert), teacher dashboard KPI/search/filter/detail/recap/add-student+immediate-login, parent dashboard single-child/history/account, and backend RBAC 403 isolation (teacher cross-group, siswa/guru/wali cross-role). No red-screen errors encountered. Only issues found are backend performance (N+1 queries slowing teacher dashboard ~6-8s and detail page ~10-15s on first load) and one cosmetic dev LogBox warning on teacher detail screen. Both are minor/non-blocking. Main agent can self-verify the perf fix by timing GET /api/teacher/students before/after refactor.
rca_of_issue: Teacher dashboard/detail slowness: routes/teacher.py list_students() and compute_recap() perform one MongoDB round-trip per student (list) or per day (recap) sequentially via await in a for-loop, rather than batching with $in or aggregation pipelines. Against MongoDB Atlas (external, higher latency than local), this compounds into multi-second waits that looked like an 'infinite spinner' during initial testing until wait times were extended to 8-15s. Mitigation: replace loops with a single db.daily_reports.find({'student_id': {'$in': ids}, 'activity_date': {'$in': dates}}) query and aggregate in Python, or use MongoDB aggregation pipeline with $lookup/$group.
